raw_excerpt: MDN: @starting-style CSS at-rule. Defines starting values for properties set on an element that you want to transition from when the element is first rendered. Required for elements that animate in (including from display: none). Now in Baseline (2024). Caveat: @starting-style rules must be placed AFTER the post-entry state declarations (as of Chrome 130). For v1, the @starting-style API is overkill — we can use plain @keyframes + animation-delay for first paint and IntersectionObserver for scroll-into-view.
